concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: Clause 1.2 states the contractual Effective Date as 1 February 2027. This is distinct from the signing date of 29 January 2027 stated in clause 1.5.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch
justifications: The sole Permitted Purpose is stated as evaluating a minority investment in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch. Operating a competing business, product development, other acquisitions and model training are excluded.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: The ordinary window end of 31 January 2028 was closed early by a valid termination notice delivered on 24 November 2027, which sets the closure effective date as 30 November 2027.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum, with Norwegian law as the governing law.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is registered in Norway under number 923 456 781 and is identified as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is registered in Sweden under number 559123-4567 and is identified as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: At the 7 April 2027 snapshot, LUMEN, SHORE, CEDAR and BASALT remain protected in full. ORACLE falls in the unprotected gap before the 8 April acceptance, and MICA is wholly excluded by proven independent development.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days after the Thursday 25 March 2027 call, excluding the listed holidays of 26 and 29 March, gives a deadline of 17:00 UTC on 5 April 2027.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection is not continuous. provisional protection ran from the 25 march 2027 oral disclosure until the 5 april 2027 17:00 utc deadline, and the late confirmation arriving 6 april 09:05 utc did not extend it. protection was restored prospectively only from the recipient's written acceptance on 8 april 2027 at 10:00 utc, leaving an unprotected gap, and because delivery rather than sending governs timeliness, the 16:58 sending on 5 april did not make the confirmation timely.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection is not continuous. Provisional protection ran from the 25 March 2027 oral disclosure until the 5 April 2027 17:00 UTC deadline, and the late confirmation arriving 6 April 09:05 UTC did not extend it. Protection was restored prospectively only from the Recipient's written acceptance on 8 April 2027 at 10:00 UTC, leaving an unprotected gap, and because delivery rather than sending governs timeliness, the 16:58 sending on 5 April did not make the confirmation timely.
justifications: The oral-information rule makes protection depend on the deadline and acceptance, and delivery is measured at arrival rather than sending. The gap runs from the expired deadline to the acceptance time.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: The prior-possession evidence covers only the older module S-17 and its incorporation in S-92. The new non-public branching map and thresholds, plus the complete S-92 combination, have no recorded prior possession, so the entire package is not excluded.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The Discloser's independent and lawful release of the entire schedule to the public on 15 June 2027 established the public-information exclusion for all of CEDAR, ending protection then. This is earlier than the 1 February 2030 duration end, which therefore does not apply.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin is the Recipient's own employee with an effective undertaking, security check and clean-room approval before the snapshot. Marek qualifies as an Affiliate employee because the Recipient's 52 percent countable votes exceed 50 percent, and all his approvals are effective by 15 September. Oskar is an external lawyer relying on a professional duty, with his security check and clean-room approval effective before the snapshot.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient directly holds 48 percent of Talus Research general shareholder votes and holds a presently effective irrevocable proxy over a further disjoint 4 percent at the access snapshot. The 6 percent covered only by a revocable proxy is excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's clean-room approval is the last requirement to become effective, on 14 September, and access cannot start before then. The Talus Research voting control was also operating on that date, so the Affiliate condition is met.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: The prohibition was lifted on 5 July 2027 at 11:20, so the earlier deadline is six continuous hours later, 17:20 that day, which falls before the 6 July production time. The after-hours deferral does not apply.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice reached the mailbox at 17:55 on 5 July 2027, against a 17:20 deadline, and compelled-disclosure notices are measured at actual arrival. That is 35 whole minutes late.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P3B is privileged and outside the duty, while P2 and P4 were withdrawn.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November 2027 before the 17:00 UTC cutoff, starting ten Business Days that exclude 25 and 26 November, so the restored WORK-1 copy must be deleted by 8 December 2027. Restoration does not restart the ordinary ten-Business-Day deadline, and the earlier return-request trigger governs over the later termination date.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The backup may remain only until the earlier of its next scheduled overwrite (30 December 2027) and 45 calendar days after the 22 November trigger (6 January 2028), so the overwrite date controls. Restoration of WORK-1 does not alter or extend that schedule.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 is the single counsel-held archive permitted under the archival exception, BK-1 is still before its overwrite and 45-day limit at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is preserved under a binding order. WORK-1 is an ordinary active copy in breach and NOTE-1 is not covered by any exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: NOTE-1 consists of deliberately recorded parameter values and notes, which the residual-knowledge permission expressly excludes, and training on it requires a separate signed licence that does not exist. No preservation order or archival arrangement covers it either.
